name: Multi-view Lenticular Volume Rendering
aliases: GPU-accelerated volume rendering to 3D lenticular displays
definition: A method for hardware-accelerated generation of multi-view stereoscopic images of volumetric medical datasets for display on a multi-view lenticular screen, using the GPU for both rendering and compositing.
summary: Multi-view Lenticular Volume Rendering is a GPU-accelerated method that generates stereoscopic volumetric images for glasses-free lenticular displays by compositing multiple perspective views into an interlaced bitmap.
